newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India subdued ahead of SBI issue.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India subdued ahead of SBI issue.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) were weaker in thin trade ahead of State Bank of India's GDR offering.
Traders believe that despite approval to raise $500 million, the issue will probably come in closer to $350 million.
"It will be quite well received, but it has capped all interest in this market," said a trader.

The James Capel Indian GDR Index fell 0.44 points, or 0.63 percent to 69.52 points, a premium of 13.71 percent over the local market after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index fell 2.99 points to 3346.78.
Most India traders spent the day recovering from their victory over Korean and East European market makers in a football match in London on Thursday.
Hotel stocks saw some buyers, Indian Hotels ended down six cents at $24.50/$25.
"The whole tone of the Indian market is weak at the moment, fundamentally it is cheap, but there are not any end-buyers," said a trader.

Other Asian markets were also weaker, the Capel Korea Index fell 1.65 points, 2.5 percent to 64.51 points, a premium of 24.92 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index fell 13.80 points to 759.35.
The Capel Taiwan Index fell 1.05 points 1.05, 1.18 percent, to 88.52 points a premium of 3.09 percent over the local market after the Taiwan Weighted Index ended down 36.07 points at 6,499.52.
